panels.title: $series
panels.description: Seconds since the newest stored sample. Green is fresh, red means the collector has been quiet long enough to be worth looking at.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT strftime('%s', 'now') - strftime('%s', MAX(s.ts)) AS "age"
FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE so.slug || '/' || se.metric = '$series'

panels.title: Series
panels.description: Every series the collector knows about. Coverage is the fraction of the last 24h explicitly marked known by a CoverageSpan — unknown time is neither covered nor zero.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT so.slug AS "source",
       so.kind AS "kind",
       se.metric AS "metric",
       se.unit AS "unit",
       so.native_resolution_s AS "native res (s)",
       so.enabled AS "enabled",
       CAST(strftime('%s', MAX(s.ts)) AS INTEGER) AS "last sample",
       strftime('%s', 'now') - strftime('%s', MAX(s.ts)) AS "age (s)",
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.ts >= datetime('now', '-24 hours') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "samples 24h",
       (SELECT MIN(100.0, 100.0 * SUM(MAX(0,
                 strftime('%s', MIN(c.end, datetime('now')))
               - strftime('%s', MAX(c.start, datetime('now', '-24 hours'))))) / 86400.0)
          FROM core_coveragespan c
         WHERE c.series_id = se.id
           AND c.end >= datetime('now', '-24 hours')
           AND c.state IN ('live', 'backfilled')) AS "coverage 24h (%)"
FROM core_series se
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
LEFT JOIN core_sample s ON s.series_id = se.id
GROUP BY se.id
ORDER BY so.kind, so.slug, se.metric

panels.title: Collector polls per 5 minutes
panels.description: Poll attempts bucketed by outcome. A source that stops polling shows up as the bars stopping, which is different from polling and failing.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(t, 300) AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ok = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "succeeded",
       SUM(CASE WHEN ok IS NOT 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "failed"
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', r.started) AS INTEGER) AS t, r.ok AS ok
  FROM core_collectorrun r
  WHERE r.started >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')
    AND r.started <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Failed polls
panels.description: Runs in the selected range that did not finish ok. A null outcome means the process died mid-poll.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', r.started) AS INTEGER) AS "started",
       so.slug AS "source",
       CASE WHEN r.ok IS NULL THEN 'died mid-run' ELSE 'failed' END AS "outcome",
       ROUND((julianday(r.finished) - julianday(r.started)) * 86400.0, 2) AS "took (s)",
       r.message AS "message"
FROM core_collectorrun r
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.ok IS NOT 1
  AND r.started >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  AND r.started <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY r.started DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Coverage spans
panels.description: Intervals whose status is explicitly known. Anything not listed here is unknown — the gap between spans is the thing to read, not the spans themselves.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', c.start) AS INTEGER) AS "start",
       CAST(strftime('%s', c.end) AS INTEGER) AS "end",
       so.slug || '/' || se.metric AS "series",
       c.state AS "state",
       ROUND((julianday(c.end) - julianday(c.start)) * 24.0, 2) AS "hours"
FROM core_coveragespan c
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = c.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE c.end >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  AND c.start < datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY c.start DESC
LIMIT 500
